description: Scrape Snapchat Ads Library / Ad Gallery for advertiser ads, sponsored content, and creator-sponsored posts.

countries.description: EU country codes to filter ads by. Leave empty for all regions. Valid codes: de, fr, it, es, pl, nl, be, se, at, pt, cz, ro, hu, dk, fi, sk, bg, hr, lt, lv, lu, si, ee, el, mt, ie, cy. Note: UK (gb) is not supported by the API.
countries.title: Countries

creatorName.description: For creatorSearch mode: creator username or name to search sponsored content
creatorName.title: Creator Name

endDate.description: Filter ads active up to this date (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no end-date filter.
endDate.title: End Date

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return. Note: adSearch mode returns up to 10 results per advertiser (API limit).
maxResults.title: Max Results

mode.description: Select the scraping mode: adSearch to search ads by advertiser, sponsoredContent to browse all sponsored content, or creatorSearch to search by creator.
mode.title: Scraping Mode

payingAdvertiserName.description: For adSearch mode: advertiser name to search. Examples: nike, coca-cola, amazon
payingAdvertiserName.title: Advertiser Name

startDate.description: Filter ads active from this date (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no start-date filter.
startDate.title: Start Date

status.description: Filter ads by their current status.
status.title: Ad Status

title: Snapchat Ads Gallery Scraper
